# goChina Events
goChina Events is an independent China supply-chain development provider for overseas companies: supplier research & vetting, quote comparison, coordinated factory audits, sampling and order milestone management — remote from day one, plus on-the-ground support in Guangzhou-Foshan and Shanghai. Trade show trip support is offered as an entry service. Not affiliated with any trade fair organizer; supplier/partner relationships disclosed at https://gochina.events/commercial-disclosure/.

## Pages
- [Home](https://gochina.events/): overview of remote supply-chain development and China visit services.
- [Trade Shows](https://gochina.events/trade-shows/): supported entry channel; verified dates where published, official organizer links.
- [Industries](https://gochina.events/industries/): eight sourcing industries with MOQs, screening points, clusters and visit notes.
- [Services](https://gochina.events/services/): supplier research & vetting, purchasing & order coordination, inspection & freight coordination, factory visits, interpreters, show support, transfers.
- [Business Trips](https://gochina.events/business-trips/): supported visit structures.
- [Pricing](https://gochina.events/pricing/): fee structure + labeled budget examples (no committed amounts).
- [Commercial disclosure](https://gochina.events/commercial-disclosure/)
- [How we screen suppliers](https://gochina.events/supplier-selection/)
- [Sample documents](https://gochina.events/templates/): trip plan, comparison sheet, visit checklist, meeting notes.
- [Buyer Meetups](https://gochina.events/buyer-meetups/): interest list; no confirmed events published.
- [Blog](https://gochina.events/blog/): one sourcing question answered daily; machine-readable feed at https://gochina.events/feed.xml (RSS).
- [Plan a project](https://gochina.events/plan-your-trip/): enquiry form; response within one business day.

Contact: email contact@gochina.events, WhatsApp +86 182 2441 6343, hours Mon–Sun 8:30–19:00 (China Standard Time).
